name: Differenzler Jass
description: Differenzler Jass is a Swiss bidding point-trick game where each player predicts tricks and points won, and penalties are based on the difference between bid and result.

overview.description: Differenzler Jass is a Swiss bidding point-trick game where each player predicts tricks and points won, and penalties are based on the difference between bid and result.

history.origins: Differenzler developed in Swiss Jass circles as a variant that rewards accurate prediction rather than only raw trick count.
timeline: 19th-20th century: Bidding and point-based Jass variants spread through Switzerland.
Modern era: Differenzler is played in clubs and home circles as a precision-scoring Jass form.
history.cultural: It is used as a social and competitive Jass variant that emphasizes judgment and memory.
history.evolution: Compared to plain point-trick Jass, Differenzler adds pre-play bidding and difference penalties that change risk-taking.

setup.players: Three or four players. Four-player tables are common.
setup.deck: Swiss 36-card Jass deck (or French-suited equivalent regional pack).
setup.dealing: Dealer deals all cards in packets of three: 9 each with 4 players, 12 each with 3 players. Trump is determined from the cut card as described in rules.

rules.objective: Minimize cumulative penalty by predicting your own card-point total as accurately as possible.
rules.gameplay: Trump suit is set by the suit of the bottom card of the cut packet. Beginning with the player to dealer's right and continuing clockwise, each player predicts a card-point total from 0 to 157. Play then proceeds anticlockwise with the player to dealer's right leading first. Usual Swiss Jass trick rules apply, including trump ranking and point values. After all tricks, each player's penalty is the absolute difference between predicted and achieved card points.
keyRules: Predictions are per player and must be between 0 and 157.
Trump suit is fixed from the cut card for the hand.
Scoring is absolute bid difference (exact prediction scores zero).
Deal and play are anticlockwise and dealer rotates to the right.

strategy.basic: Bid conservatively when your hand has weak trump control.
strategy.intermediate: Use early trick information to adjust card timing toward bid fulfillment.
strategy.advanced: Balance point-card capture against overbidding risk to keep long-run penalty low.
tips: Track high trumps that have already been played.
Do not chase extra tricks if your bid is already secure and penalties are difference-based.

variations.name: Secret Predictions
variations.description: Players write predictions privately and reveal after play.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes prediction visibility; no engine constant overrides needed.

variations.name: Exact-Hit Bonus
variations.description: An exact prediction scores -10 instead of 0 (with special handling for a prediction of 0).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring tweak only; no engine phase or constant overrides required.

variations.name: Stock Plus/Minus
variations.description: Declaring Stock allows choosing +20 or -20 card points at declaration time.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Declaration bonus; overrides could be added later for cardVisibility or scoring constants.

scoring.description: Each player's hand penalty is the absolute difference between predicted and achieved card points. Lower cumulative penalty is better.
scoring.winCondition: After an agreed equal-dealer session length, the player with the lowest cumulative penalty wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Swiss point-trick Jass where bid accuracy drives scoring pressure.
